name: sqlite-encrypted-cordova-equipment-checkout-example
description: Encrypted equipment checkout app using Cordova and SQLite.Encrypted

scripts.check: node --check www/js/database.js && node --check www/js/app.js && node --check scripts/configure.mjs && node --check scripts/cordova.mjs
scripts.add:android: npm run configure && node scripts/cordova.mjs platform add android --nosave && node scripts/cordova.mjs plugin add @sqlite-encrypted/cordova --nosave
scripts.add:ios: npm run configure && node scripts/cordova.mjs platform add ios --nosave && node scripts/cordova.mjs plugin add @sqlite-encrypted/cordova --nosave
scripts.prepare:android: npm run configure && node scripts/cordova.mjs prepare android
scripts.prepare:ios: npm run configure && node scripts/cordova.mjs prepare ios
scripts.build:android: npm run configure && node scripts/cordova.mjs build android
scripts.build:ios: npm run configure && node scripts/cordova.mjs build ios
scripts.android: npm run configure && node scripts/cordova.mjs run android
scripts.ios: npm run configure && node scripts/cordova.mjs run ios
